details: Subterranean Staircase Access Only: The main self-manifested sanctum is situated 10 feet below ground level and is accessible strictly via a flight of concrete stairs.
No Elevators, Lifts, or Ramps: No elevators, lifts, or ramp access facilities are documented for descending into the subterranean chamber.
Accessibility for Elderly/Differently-Abled: Wheelchair access is not supported into the main subterranean sanctum. Devotees requiring physical assistance must negotiate concrete steps.
